messages.author: 0f5b7adb7e70bd8b
messages.subject: New release: simmer 3.8.0
parts:
Hi all,

A new release hit CRAN yesterday, and Windows binaries are already
available for r-devel and r-release. This release includes two new
major features that have been discussed in this list.

The first of them is a new data source that allows us to attach a data
frame to a trajectory. For each row, the simulator creates a new
arrival: one column must contain the (relative or absolute) arrival
time, and the other columns can be used to automatically initialise
priorities and attributes. And of course, this data source can be
combined with dynamic generators. See ?add_dataframe for further
details.

The second feature is the ability to offload monitoring data to disk
(to CSV files). By default, monitoring is still performed in memory,
but now we can change that in the simulator instantiation. See ?simmer
and ?monitor for further information and examples on how to define and
use an on-disk monitor.

Please, take a look at the changelog for a comprehensive list of changes:

https://r-simmer.org/news/index.html#simmer-3-8-0

Regards,
Iñaki
